Accounts for all seven hit categories (no no-hit classes) and states scan limits thoroughly (curated cards, static-only, unexecuted validation layers), but the recommendations never explicitly propose a target-version build/typecheck, isolated cold boot, or a functional end-to-end path as next steps — they are only implied in the limits narrative.
